# MONTHS_BETWEEN with DATETIME: fractional days, microseconds, same-day and month-end
# rules, the supported range, and NULL propagation. Inputs prevent constant folding.

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2008-02-29 00:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '2008-02-28 12:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2008-02-29 00:00:00.123456' AS a, DATETIME '2008-02-28 00:00:00.789012' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2008-04-15 06:15:45' AS a, DATETIME '2008-05-10 12:30:15' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-03-14 23:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '2025-02-14 00:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-02-28 23:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '2025-03-31 00:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-11-30 00:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '2025-10-29 00:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-10-29 00:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '2025-11-30 00:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '0001-01-01 00:00:00' AS a, DATETIME '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-03-15 00:00:00.000001' AS a, DATETIME '2025-02-14 00:00:00' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS a, DATETIME '2025-01-01 01:33:12' AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(DATETIME '2025-01-01 01:33:12' AS a, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS b)]) AS x
?>

SELECT MONTHS_BETWEEN(x.a, x.b)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS a, CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS b)]) AS x
?>
